changes: New in the beta: the enemy heatmap matches the ground the enemies covered. Squares are about 100 yards on a zone map, get finer as you zoom into a continent, and heat fades out over the hour.
Battlegrounds: your group leader can give teammates class, role or other icons above their nameplates and on raid frames, to find them among strangers. Open them with /hg icons.
Battlegrounds settings have tabs for 10v10, 15v15, Epic and Open world, each with its own settings (/hg sizes). Profiles belong to each character; copy, export or import them on the Profiles page.
Nearby: in open-world group fights, the Nearby list becomes your kill order, with ranks, health and an eye for enemies targeting you, instead of opening a second board.
Bounties: cleaner wanted posters that say who posted the reward, with dates in your display language and your game clock's format.
notice: This is a beta: on CurseForge or Wago, allow beta files for Highground to get it. Coming from 3.3 or earlier, restart the game after updating; /reload is not enough because 3.4.0 adds new addon files.
